meta_description:
1,820 likes, 269 comments - yourfoodlab on October 9, 2026: "YOU DON’T NEED TO CHANGE YOUR COOKWARE to cook on this ELECTRIC COOKTOP! 🤯❤️

You can now cook with your favourite flat-bottom pots and pans, whether they’re induction-compatible or not!

Meet the all-new Cüraa Infrared Cooktop! ❤️

The same beautiful design and intuitive cooking experience you loved on our best-selling Indie Pro!

✨ An electric cooktop that looks as good as it cooks!
 🎛️ Gas-like heat control with a simple regulator
 ⏱️ Timer & Keep Warm function for up to 99 minutes
 🔒 Child Lock for added safety

No complicated controls, just simple, convenient and enjoyable cooking!

A lot of you told us you wanted an electric cooktop that works with the cookware you already own. And that’s exactly what inspired us to create this!

Available in 2 beautiful colours, exclusively on Amazon! And with the Great Indian Festival Sale LIVE, it’s a great time to bring one home! 🛒

Happy cooking! ❤️

Love,
Sanjyot & Team Cüraa".
